bio.text: Brian Nathan represents District 14 in the Florida Senate, to which Nathan was elected on March 24, 2026.
The Senate lists Nathan's occupation as electrician. Nathan served in the U.S. Navy as a cryptologist technician from 2003 to 2008.
Nathan holds a B.A. in philosophy and sociology from the University of Tampa (2012). Nathan was born in Port Chester, New York, and moved to Florida in 2008.
